findings.text: The structured after_suite record names revision 6346aa9f5 and tree mcintos-suite-8cORWv, but the log path it cites was produced at 7fbf45c44 in tree mcintos-suite-54Kbet, so the arm cannot be re-run from the record as written even though its failure ids match the delivered head.

"admitted" is len(edges) minus the count of distinct refusal row ids, so a single component-level refusal subtracts one from the admitted total instead of excluding every edge of that component, misreporting the count in the receipt.

_edge_archive_has_cycle re-implements directed cycle detection that catalog_ordering._find_cyclic_components (line 186) already owns and that the census applies to the same REFINED_FROM relation, so this duplicates a shared owner rather than wrapping it.

multi_tip_components rises from 18 to 19 because archiving the superseded-to-live edge makes toroidal_plasma_momentum_diffusivity a live tip alongside toroidal_momentum_diffusion_coefficient, and the landing fragment and manifest do not report or explain that second live tip.
